from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path.cwd().parent if Path.cwd().name == "docs" else Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "docs" / "lancet"))

import render_helpers as rh
from report_helpers import kpis, number

counts = rh.summary_counts("manuscript", "en")
kpis([
    (str(counts["paragraphs"]), "Paragraphs of the article (summary, research in context, introduction, methods, results, discussion and declarations)"),
    (str(counts["tables"]), "Tables of the article"),

This page reproduces the **article** as printed by version 10 of the manuscript: the text, the numbered citations, the two tables and the four figures come from `docs/lancet/data/contenido_v10.json`, exported by the document builder (`export_docs_content.py`) with every figure already resolved. The plates shown are not copies: `docs/lancet/figuras_principales.py` produces them from the public tables of `docs/lancet/data/` (copies of `outputs/tidy` and of the verified data of revision 10), with the same code as the submitted version, in English and Spanish; every plate links to its 175 mm PNG (300 dpi), SVG and PDF files. The Spanish text is in the same JSON. The [supplementary material](lancet_supplement.html) reproduces the extended methods, the complementary results, tables S1–S9 and figures S1–S9; the [extended corpus](lancet_corpus.html) collects the plates and tables of the earlier versions of the study.

Case definition: GRD episodes with an eligible F84 code, excluding Rett syndrome (F84.2); REM programmes with the strict autism code except where "F84 family" is indicated. All counts are administrative recognition, not prevalence or incidence. Statements in square brackets are decisions pending from the authors.
